scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:client && npm run start:prod --prefix server
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:client && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:client && npm run build --prefix desktop
